topology: Use the shared ALL-land G/W/S occupancy. Grass, wood and stone have identical organic256 alpha. Connected contacts never receive a cap or outline.
renderOrder: all bottom finishes, all grass tops, all wood/stone tops, raised grass and props
sourceProcessing: Fresh native flat V11 material atlas crops; opposing edges match by mechanical mirror repetition. No old bridge raster interiors or palette quantization are used.
